title: Ty Dolla $ign Celebrates Grammy Nominations With Ty Dolla $ign & Friends – the EZMNY JAMMJAM Pre-Grammys Party
summary: The event -- presented by Amazon Music and Jammcard -- will feature surprise guest performers.
contentText:
Ty Dolla $ign is kicking off Grammy weekend with a bang. Ty and his EZMNY Records label will host Ty Dolla $ign & Friends – The EZMNY JammJam on Jan. 28 in Los Angeles, which will feature performances from Ty Dolla and plenty of special guests.

Presented by Amazon Music and Jammcard, the event will be livestreamed on Prime Video , Twitch and Amazon Music on Jan. 28 from 9 p.m. to 11 p.m. PT.

“We founded EZMNY with a simple goal in mind: bring back good music by discovering, developing, supporting and celebrating real artists,” CEO/cofounder of EZMNY Records Ty Dolla $ign tells Billboard .

EZMNY Records CEO/cofounder Shawn Barron adds: “With 11 Grammy nominations this year across our whole label between Ty, Leon Thomas and Bizzy Crook, there’s no better way to celebrate than with good music from real artists. Shout-out to Amazon Music and Jammcard for helping us bring this event to life.”

While searching for his first win, Ty Dolla $ign picked up his seventh nomination via the 2026 Grammy Awards for his assist alongside 6LACK on J.I.D.’s God Does Like Ugly standout “Wholeheartedly” in the best melodic rap performance category.

Rising R&B superstar Leon Thomas notched six Grammy nominations, including nods for best new artist and album of the year for Mutt . EZMNY signee Bizzy Crook also picked up four nominations for his work on Mutt .

Earlier in January, Ty Dolla $ign’s “Don’t Kill the Party” single featuring Juicy J and Quavo debuted on the Billboard Hot 100 at No. 96.
